summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, furnishing an intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI listing obligations. The filing notifies exchanges (NSE, BSE, NYSE) of management's scheduled participation in investor conferences on June 9-10, 2026, hosted by ICICI Securities and Macquarie in Mumbai and Hyderabad, respectively. No special-situation transaction, material corporate event, or strategic initiative is disclosed. The filing is a routine disclosure of investor meeting schedules by a foreign private issuer, corresponding to no US-equivalent special situation. No deal terms apply.
